In 2025, our main focus has been on community requests and quality of life updates. At the same time,  we’ve added a new game mode, added Block Lists, and fixed a LOT of bugs.

3.20 lands at the start of next month with an overhaul to Balanced Blitz dice and our first ever Community Map Pack.


Balanced Blitz Dice Update 
The Balanced Blitz system was added in 2019 to provide more predictable battle outcomes by instantly determining the result of a battle without players having to watch hundreds or thousands of dice rolls in larger games. 3.20 brings some major improvements. 

We’ve fine-tuned the logic behind Blitz rolls to ensure results feel more consistent and fair, without losing the speed Blitz is known for.

Learn more about the changes coming to blitz in our Dev Diary.



New Maps! - Community Map Pack
The Community Map Pack is our first ever collaboration between the RISK team and four map designers from the RISK community. These maps were designed straight from the community Discord’s 2023 Map Design Competition and will be available shortly after 3.20 goes live.


Here’s a look at the box art:

Quality of Life Improvements & Bugfixes

Fixed the bug where surrendering players waited to bot out in Neutral AI games

Flags for surrendering, bot-controlled and botted out players have been cleaned up

A camera pass to improve zoom and navigation across all our maps

A wider map pass to fix connections, territory cards and visual glitches

Audio rendering issues around menus and ads (stutter bugs) 



Check the full release notes when the update goes live.


What do you think about the upcoming Update 3.20? Let us know your thoughts, and tell us what you’d like to see next! Update 3.20 is expected to release by the start of September, so keep your eyes peeled for more details as we get closer.

notes.title: NETWORK OVERHAUL UPDATE
notes.notes:
We’re entering the final stages of our long-planned network overhaul: a complete rebuild of Risk’s multiplayer backend. This update is designed to:

Improve game stability and recovery

Shut down most forms of cheating

Lay the groundwork for future multiplayer features


FIRST CLOSED BETA IN Q3
After years of internal development and testing, we’re ready to take the next step: real-world testing. The first closed beta will begin in August/July for a limited group of international players.



This will be a small group - if you signed up for beta access earlier this year, we will be running a much wider playtest later in the year and will be contacting players about that soon. 



This beta build is based on v3.16,  so it won’t include recent features like Secret Missions or the new Map Select screen. The goal here is to test the core networking under real player conditions.



It’s taken a while to get here - this overhaul was first roadmapped back in 2019 - and it’s been a bumpy road since then with delays, technical hurdles and global pandemics. That said, hitting our first beta is a major milestone.  


WHAT WILL BE DIFFERENT?
Not much, and that’s the point. This is a backend upgrade, so games should feel largely the same. You may notice:

Fewer disconnects and crashes

More secure, cheat-resistant matches and less hackers

More recovered games, with faster recovery times when a player drops



One area we’re still fine-tuning is input responsiveness. Server-side validation can introduce slight delays - especially for fast-fingered PC users - but it’s key to preventing exploits. We’re working to strike the right balance between responsiveness, security and maintaining an even playing field between mobile and PC players.


WHY THIS OVERHAUL MATTERS
Risk’s current system relies on the host’s device to manage the game, which creates all kinds of issues. If the host drops, the game can be lost forever. Worse, with the right tools, players can tamper with game state or intercept packets in flight between clients.


The new system runs on authoritative servers, removing that dependency. This means:

Better security and stability

Recoverable games

Protection against most known hacks and packet manipulation
 

Server-authoratative games also open up possible future features that we couldn’t explore otherwise. After the network overhaul we can explore long requested features like:

Asynchronous games

Multiplayer save slots

Better spectator modes


WHY IT TOOK SO LONG
We underestimated the complexity early on. The original plan was to put the whole team on it and move fast - we soon realised that would mean halting all other Risk development.



So we changed tactics. This year we’ve kept a small, dedicated team focused on the overhaul while others worked on features like Secret Missions, new UI updates, block lists and future content we’ll be announcing in the coming months.



That slowed the overhaul down but it kept the rest of the game moving.



Now, with the core work behind us and real player testing ahead, we’re closer than ever to shipping this major upgrade.



Thanks for your patience. You can still sign up to express interest in our betas here. 


Team@SMG

notes.title: BOT OUT TIMER UPDATE, PT.2
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/69da6056197ecc745da722f4dd3984c829d10e07.png"]

A few weeks ago, we posted an update to our bot out timers. One of those changes involved closing loopholes that made it too easy for players to bypass the bot out timer and sneak into the end game. 


How the Bot Out Timer Works:
Mobile: The timer starts automatically only when a player backgrounds or closes the app during a match.


PC: Minimizing the game or switching windows does not trigger the bot out timer. Inactivity is only tracked during your turn.


If the player is on PC, or the player is running the mobile app in the foreground, they will always receive a warning before AI takeover, and there is a generous window to return before being fully botted out.



[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcKB1g856arzcPqVPwv4lRUWGZPrMi4qoI0X1lKcToQrEUNBaEXmPqh9FiCzgD2B8KXBZvnTr_3ZInBNJDLeM0tak8MjbFe41ImnLi0X15BDl4z07w-5is8VhTzTZPMoBn-RrjT8g?key=6txuYh89h_nBS9seynlLxA"]

What’s Changing:



To improve flexibility, we’re increasing the bot out timer from 180 seconds to 600 seconds (10 minutes). This gives players more time to return before triggering a bot out.



We’re continuing to fine-tune this system based on your feedback, so please keep it coming.



Thanks to everyone who’s taken the time to share their thoughts.



Over and out,

– SMG: Team RISK

notes.title: RISK: BOT OUT TIMER UPDATE
notes.notes:
Edit: We've been mulling this over and have decided to change the bot out timers back to 600 seconds for the time being. There's still more we want to do to the bot out system to make it fair and unexploitable, and we're going to keep working on it for now. Thanks to everyone who has chimed in here, or on discord. Read the new update here.



In 3.18 releases (including hotfixes) we made some adjustments to the overall timings of players being forced out of games.


Prior to our recent release, we’ve received reports of players exploiting the botting out logic. Players had been found to enter a lobby and ready up before minimizing the app, letting an AI take over and the game play out, before resuming at a later time to determine if the game was worth continuing or not. This created a bad user experience for all other players involved. 


With the most recent release, we have ensured that regardless of whether a player leaves the app foregrounded or backgrounded that they will be kicked from the game if they exceed the new time limit.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/fd594d670ee5990e047c9f34079d56b5d4abc242.jpg"]



----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Changes
The newly adjusted timings for the game are set up as such that after 50 seconds of inactivity on their turn a player will receive a pop down warning, after 60 seconds of inactivity on their turn an AI takeover will occur. If a player remains inactive and crosses the new threshold of three minutes they will be removed from the game permanently, the way this three minute timer is calculated varies depending on the bot out style.


[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXccpnEFKPJ4QgLzRaVgYkxymwLynkvePrZel19gIijJdu2tJuW51dDy1iwdtjcJFTv9u7rygcT69P_O5bxgx3bQYiCFUX5wu7LRFaysVvmFnpvzYzfv1F6UB92NRzQLFif-ipZw3g?key=A3hvCJzImZi__P3N6VDQhg"]
Foreground
If players bot out and keep the app foregrounded their inactive timer dictates their ability to re-join the game or not. A player's inactivity timer increments on their turn from the last moment of activity and continues to increment on their turn while their AI replacement plays. If the inactivity timer exceeds the time limit then they are automatically kicked out of the game and sent back to the home screen. 


Background
If players minimize the app, sending it to the background, then a countdown timer is started on our servers. This timer is counted in real time and begins decrementing after the host has acknowledged the disconnected player and notified the server, in this instance there may be some leeway in the three minute deadline. If they exceed the time limit then they are unable to re-join the game when they re-focus the app, instead they are redirected back to the home screen.


----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If you have any more questions about botting out, reach out to us by submitting a support ticket or contacting us on social media:

Facebook

Instagram

X

TikTok

Over and out,

– SMG: Team RISK

notes.title: RISK: WHAT’S COMING TO UPDATE v3.19
notes.notes:
We’ve said this before, but it’s worth repeating; 2025 is a BIG year for Risk.

In Update 3.18, we released the Secret Assassin Beta game mode, balanced Secret Missions, and rolled out several quality-of-life improvements. (You can read the full breakdown of Update 3.18 here).

Update 3.19 builds on this, with a focus on improving the experience for both players and content creators. We’ve been listening closely to your feedback, and we’re introducing new tools to make games fairer and more enjoyable for everyone. 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

BOT-OUT TIMERS
Our first part of the update is actually live already. Prior to our recent release we received reports of players exploiting the botting out logic. Players had been found to enter a lobby and ready up before minimizing the app, letting an AI take over and the game play out, before resuming at a later time to determine if the game was worth continuing or not. This created a bad user experience for all other players involved. With the most recent release we have ensured that regardless of whether a player leaves the app foregrounded or backgrounded that they will be kicked from the game if they exceed the new time limit. The newly adjusted timings for the game are set up as such that after 50 seconds of inactivity on their turn a player will receive a pop down warning, after 60 seconds of inactivity on their turn an AI takeover will occur. If a player remains inactive and crosses the new threshold of three minutes they will be removed from the game permanently, the way this three minute timer is calculated varies depending on the bot out style.

If players bot out and keep the app foregrounded their inactive timer dictates their ability to re-join the game or not. A player's inactivity timer increments on their turn from the last moment of activity and continues to increment on their turn while their AI replacement plays. If the inactivity timer exceeds the time limit then they are automatically kicked out of the game and sent back to the home screen. If players minimize the app, sending it to the background, then a countdown timer is started on our servers. This timer is counted in real time and begins decrementing after the host has acknowledged the disconnected player and notified the server, in this instance there may be some leeway in the three minute deadline. If they exceed the time limit then they are unable to re-join the game when they re-focus the app, instead they are redirected back to the home screen.


BLOCK BUTTON
One of your most-requested features is finally coming: Block Lists. This new tool allows you to choose who you don’t want to play or interact with again. 

1. Manage your Block List: Currently, players are using their friends list to act as a list of players to avoid. We’re making it so players can add and remove players from their block lists. A player can block from the pregame lobby up until the post game results screen. Now is the time to turn your ‘friends’ list into an actual friends list. 😂 True definition of keeping your friends close and enemies closer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/56a4a31d6d95641e0b20f2e03ea2c688b58b9a02.png

2. Prevent unwanted players joining your lobby: Once you have blocked a player, they will be unable to see or join any public or private lobbies you are hosting.


3. You’ll receive a message if a blocked player joins or is in your pregame lobby: If a blocked player joins a lobby you are in, you’ll receive a warning message. The blocked player will be marked with an icon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/fb74b97c5212c43f34b0460d17252f415c90651b.png

While we know this isn't a complete solution to unfair play and cheating, we believe it’ll significantly improve your overall experience and make it easier to find players who are worth playing with.


A SAFER SPACE FOR THE COMMUNITY
We love our content creators and we've heard them loud and clear when they've told us the challenges they face streaming Risk live. It only takes one or two bad eggs to ruin the streaming experience - whether it's by using a stream to snipe a game they're playing with a creator, or just messing with a creator because you know people are watching.

The block lists above are a good start, but we're taking further steps to make it a safer, more enjoyable place for creators to share live gameplay.

We’re adding some robust enhancements to our Streamer Mode to help streamers avoid trolls and stream snipers, and make it easier to create Risk content.

1. Streamer Mode Improvements: Streamer Mode now provides stronger identity protection by generating randomized names, avatars, colors, and countries for all players in the pre-game lobby—including the streamer. Real identities are only revealed once the match officially begins, helping prevent targeted sniping. Additionally, map previews and game settings are hidden in the pre-game lobby for added privacy.

2. New Report Type: Stream Sniper: We’re giving everyone a way to officially report stream sniping behavior. This helps us build better tools to detect and take action against those trying to ruin a good game.

3. Players cannot re-enter pregame lobby when kicked out by Host: We understand how frustrating it can be when kicked players repeatedly rejoin your lobby. As of 3.19, kicked players will receive a message: “You cannot rejoin this game as you have been recently kicked by the host”. The game will also become hidden from their available lobbies, and has no timeout. This is a great global feature for all players.


POSTGAME STEP FOR PLAYERS WHO SURRENDER
We’re adding a new postgame step for players who surrender early. Previously, leaving a match meant missing clarity around your final placement. Now, surrendering players will clearly see their final position (3rd, 4th, 5th etc.), along with a message that Battle Points will be awarded once final results are determined. 

Players who surrender are still allowed to block, add friend requests and like the map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/5f4d8d1f73d2f0bac18b044b482afeba08b79d45.gif


BUGFIXES
Our team has also tackled a large number of bugs such as:

 Duplicate territory cards breaking card limits on maps.
 The Gameplay settings, Colourblind Mode, Screen Res and Screen Type all display English.
 Charleroi Farm Territory missing connection to Diary.
 Disabling Streamer mode making lobby modifiers disappear.
 Difficulty settings being overridden after a Secret Assassin game.

There will be a full list in the release notes once the update is out!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

What do you think about the upcoming Update 3.19? Let us know your thoughts, and tell us what you’d like to see next!

Update 3.19 is expected to release in June, so keep your eyes peeled for more details as we get closer.

Over and out
SMG: Team RISK

notes.title: RISK Update v3.18 Release Notes
notes.notes:
A new game mode, community requested features and quality of life updates and then we’re heading back to Risk’s roots with a Napoleon themed map and cosmetics pack.

[previewyoutube=A55vDlefv2w;full]Risk: Global Domination - Update 3.18.[/previewyoutube]

FEATURES
[olist]
 New Game Mode: Secret Assassin Secret Assassin mode has entered open beta! Hunt a random enemy player while you try to evade the player hunting you. 
 New Content: Napoleon’s Battles Map Pack & Cosmetics Featuring 4 new maps and a cosmetic pack straight from the fields of France. More on this below.
[/olist]
MAJOR IMPROVEMENTS
[olist]
 Turn Timers 

 Dynamic Turn Timers have come to risk! Dynamic Turn Timers add extra time whenever you perform an extra attack with a little more going to mobile users to help with those late game power plays. You can turn them on in the Game Modifiers screen. For now they’re optional and in private (friends) only but let us know what you think - love it, hate it, or have more suggestions. We’ll continue to visit this in 3.19.
 For people wanting a faster game now these options are in, we’ve added a 30s and 45s option to the base timer - available in public (casual) and private (friends) games.

 Secret Missions We’ve made more changes to Secret Missions since launching the game mode last year:

 Someone achieving your objective doesn’t end the game Players who have their mission fulfilled outside their turn will now draw a fresh objective. Keep shooting, soldier!
 Better 1v1 Balance We’ve done a sweep and rebalance of mission objectives for 1v1 games. ‘Occupy X’ missions should be better balanced now compared to the others. No more turn one wins!
 New overlays All Secret Mission mission types now have interactive overlays to help you visualise your goals.

 Map Screen Some more improvements to our new Map Screen, including:

 Map Packs Tab shows all maps sorted into map packs.
 Recently Purchased category has been added to the Categories screen.
 Support for Mac Magic Mouse added.
 Timers now display time remaining for free maps and sales.
 Better filter handling on the All Maps screen.

[/olist]MINOR IMPROVEMENTS
[olist]
 Camera animations disabled for new players by default on their first MP game You can turn them back on in settings - but should result in faster games all round.
 Shorter bot-out timers for disconnecting players Players have 3m now to rejoin after losing their connection (was previously 10m and prone to abuse).
 Smarter automatic Territory Card trades The game will automatically offer smarter suggestions for card trades - no more suggesting to trade in an extra wild or +2 just cuz.
 Confirm Capital Placement in Capitals mode Misclicking your capital placement is now a thing of the past with a new confirmation step added to the flow.
[/olist]
BUGFIXES & MINOR IMPROVEMENTS[olist]
 Fixed three broken achievements: Better Luck Next Time, Matchmaker & Land Baron.
 Blizzard placements should no longer be able to make games unwinnable in some Secret Missions.
 Fixed some visual bugs relating to Among Us dice and Dune troops.
 The Viking Conquest map pack now has correct art.
 Improved optimization for the new map screen on android devices.
 Push notification reminders for new users should show up more reliably - existing users may get one more reminder to turn on notifications after this update.
 The shop and cosmetics screen have seem some small fixes: discount flags should show more reliably and shop content should be sorted in more meaningful orders.
 Fixed broken connections on Among Us Polus.
 The Syrian Flag profile badge has been updated.
[/olist]
NEW MAP PACK & COSMETICS

notes.title: NETWORK OVERHAUL UPDATE
notes.notes:
Attention generals, on behalf of the team, I would like to update you on the latest RISK Q4 2023 roadmap, specifically the networking overhaul and address any concerns you may have.

We want to assure you that we hear your voices and understand the frustrations some of you experience with the current multiplayer experience in RISK.

For context, RISK currently relies on a third party networking solution for multiplayer features which we are in the process of changing. As part of this change we are re-working the game’s entire multiplayer functionality to give us better overall stability, security and performance of all RISK multiplayer games.

It will also allow us to add the ability to play games over extended periods of time (ie play games over days/weeks) which we think will allow people to fit more RISK into their lives as they can chip away at Global Domination in short bursts.

Our backend team (which is separate from the team creating the maps, dice and troops) have been working on this update for over a year and it continues to be a top priority for us, even though it is taking longer than initially anticipated. While we initially aimed to roll out the new networking solution by the end of 2023, we've opted for a more deliberate approach, prioritising stability and design quality.

With our current milestones, we’re aiming to release the networking overhaul early to mid 2024.

Our team will continue to work on critical maintenance tasks and release content based updates (including the most recent 3.13 update) while our development team focuses on the multiplayer overhaul.

Thank you for your support.

Team RISK@SMG.

notes.title: Major RISK Update v3.8, our biggest update for 2022!
notes.notes:
Attention RISK Generals! 
Welcome to RISK v3.8!
What a HUGE update we have for you with a whole new game mode, ranking updates, some big updates to our UI, as well as some quality of life improvements.


PORTALS
Jump across the board, portals are here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/4e76f813d12910cc78f7db072717c557011fab59.gif

Portals is a brand new game mode that can be turned on/off like Blizzards and Fog of War. 

Portal locations are randomised each game, creating new links between non-adjacent territories. There are two ways to play: Stable and Unstable portals. 

Stable portals: portals will remain in the same location for the duration of the game.
Unstable portals: portals will change locations throughout the game and be unusable for one turn while they re-spawn. 

Portals are premium exclusive for hosting players, however any player can join a game with portals enabled. 

The following game modes modifiers will now be premium-exclusive for hosting players.

 Portals
 Zombies
 Blizzards
 Fog of War

Non-premium players are still able to join any games in these modes and with these modifiers, however you will need Premium to be able to create games in these modes and with these modifiers. Blizzards, Fog of War and Zombie Apocalypse are still able to be played solo in scenarios only by all players


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/69efd8bf6f76f39d5cdb56c31bb4f691f54f16cc.png


RANKING CHANGES
We want to thank you for playing our game and giving us feedback on how we can improve it.
The RISK player base and community have provided some great feedback around the current ranking system, so we’ve made some changes to address the feedback we’ve received. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/61d547fdf4cc65de7509290e05c610cac087336d.png


1v1 and FFA Split
We have split Ranked into 1v1 and Free-For-All (FFA), each with their own ELO ranking system and leaderboard. Your current rank will be refected in the FFA rank system. All players will start fresh in their 1v1 rank. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/695e6ae2695427ba1b6e0283cfd099843f34b2ae.png

Rank Points Visibility
Your profile now shows your rank skill points for 1v1 and FFA.*

*skill points displayed are now divided by 100 to make them easier to read for example a Grandmaster with 2.6 million skill points is now 2,600,000 / 100 = 26,000)

Rank Decay
Ranks will be “soft reset” and/or “decayed” each season, depending on if the player has played or not.


 If you have completed a qualifying game in the previous season, your ranking class will be dropped to the bottom of the rank class you are currently in. 
 For each season that you do not play a ranked game, your ranking points will be dropped to the bottom of the previous rank class. Note that this will stack - meaning if you do not play any qualifying games for three seasons in a row, your rank will decay by three rank classes. 
 This will apply individually to both the 1v1 system and FFA ranking system. This means if you play a 1v1 ranked game but no FFA, then your 1v1 ranking points will be reset to the bottom of your current rank and FFA rank class will go back to the previous rank class,
 You will still need to complete a ranked game to be shown on the leaderboard each season.


NEW HOME SCREEN AND SETTINGS UI
We have made an overhaul to our Home and Setting screens to make it easier for players to navigate, create and join games (and show off your shiny new troop and dice)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/cfb10e6fb82a0c00d14921c627f4dd98cb590a79.png

OTHER

Neutral Territories (AI Inactivity Behavior) 
Players can now set the behaviour of the AI that will take over when another player is inactive or disconnects from a game.

Automated: Player is taken over by a standard bot. 
Neutral: Player is taken over by a neutral bot that will not attack. After 10 minutes they will forfeit.

Bug fixes

 Dice mode will now automatically reset to Blitz after every turn
 Message displayed when you hit the daily Battle Points cap  
 Fixed visual bugs with territory UI in game
 Fixed iOS Facebook login issues
 Fixed arrow keys now able to change draft numbers 
 Yellow popups now accept the enter key as input 
 Fixed Battle Points level up animations 

…and more!

Keep an eye on the in game news posts for helpful tips, updates and FAQ's on the new features in v3.8

This has been a really big update for us and we are really excited for you to play it! We have another smaller update with more Battle Points levels and rewards as well as some new dice planned for later this month as well as a shiny new map pack to finish of 2022. 

Our next major gameplay update will be in 2023. 


Signing off, 
The RISK Team @ SMG

In v3.0 players will have the ability to choose their avatar frames. Admittedly it’s pretty limited with two choices but we have LOTS more in the works. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/525ff60d79f8a2ac577d9af2529154ff1a2c5743.jpg
Above is a sneak peak at the Prime Gaming avatar frame exclusive to our Prime members. More info here: https://amazon.com/risk 

And here’s an even sneakier peek at more concepts still in development.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/1709e42022afa3392003e9f6b2df2dc837e0f619.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/24a3a87800afab0f78b968f09b4a699b0bb083cb.jpg

Updated Avatars

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/6457cf99c64c0a2b7da20b8f5fade6397df8dc55.jpg

All the current avatars have been lovingly repainted by hand in our basement workshop. In v3.0+ they’ll no longer be tinted based on player colour, but will have permanent colours (shown above). 

Handy Tip: During gameplay, player colours will now be represented by the coloured avatar frame and background.  


New Feature: Blitz Attack Limit

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/51e1ddb24616f1210cbf30a9724629f307f1fa25.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/b19879b484be1741affc71e3bd3709335faa083c.png

Blitz is great for speeding up dice roll attacks, but sometimes you just don’t want to go all in. Until now there was no way to set troop limits in Blitz attack. After a lot* of player requests we squirreled away some developer hours and built the Blitz Attack Limiter™, now available in v3.0.

*Or as they say in Australia, “heaps!”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/0c2c3b62274d2c5c3668bd9f5d0b6aeb34852b5f.png
Handy tip: The striped section represents the minimum of troops to attack with (1 troop), so the slider will not go below this.


RISK Season 2

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/3783f917eb0204b0038724b090113f775d4a7e8a.jpg

From March 1st a new season of RISK battles begins (Season 1 lasted 5 years but we don't expect Season 2 to last that long), and our global leaderboards will be reset.
Your rank points will not be changed, but you'll temporarily see '0' for your profile rank (this is your position on the Global Seasonal leaderboard). Just complete one ranked Global Domination game in this new season to see your updated profile rank. You'll be placed back on the leaderboard as soon as that game is finished by all players.

Check out the official RISK Global Leaderboards here https://www.hasbrorisk.com/en/ 

This is the first step towards some major rank and season improvements that we've planned for this year.

Map Change Log

Japan

Earth 2209 A.D

Canada

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/748494837bdf5b4b867346a3b09d263c5d779de0.png


 Removed wrong connection between Tete-a-la-Balein and Gander.



Minor Changes:

 Dracula’s Castle: puck position adjustment to be more readable.
 The Younger Scrolls: made the dashed line connection between Stormway and Woldtheim easier to read.
 Red Sands Fort: minor visual changes for better legibility. 
 Himeji Castle: minor visual changes for better legibility.
 Central America: Changed the name Haiti => Dominican Republic, Changed the name Vera Cruz => Veracruz.
 + minor visual fixes to troop piece locations on multiple maps.



General fixes & improvements

Improvements


 Zombie Apocalypse: ‘Zombie Break Out’ Announcement much faster and can tap to skip. 
 Defeated players can now spectate in Play Friends mode with Fog of War setting enabled.
 New improved dice.



Major Fixes:


 Fix for ‘frozen’ UI preventing gameplay. Caused by tapping ‘?’ help button while moving troops during draft, attack or fortify.
 Fix for ‘x’ close button not working when viewing your territory cards during a game.
 Fix for players being unable to check their territory cards during an opponent’s turn in multiplayer.
 Fix for frozen ui preventing further play when timer expires while you’re attacking and rolling manual dice.


Minor > Medium Fixes

Multiple fixes and improvements. Noteworthy:


 Fix for language settings not being saved after relaunching application.
 Fix for missing help content after triggering ‘help’ button during gameplay. 
 Fix to clear battle log data after choosing ‘replay’ in single player games.
 Updated the misleading wording of ‘player defeated’ message in 70% domination when an opponent is eliminated but the game has not yet been won.

More to Come

Don’t forget the officially community run Discord is also the place to chat with all the other RISK fans like you, well maybe not exactly like you as you’re special.


Phew! What an update! There’s still more to come in 3.1 which is due April but we wanted to get this update out to test the new cosmetics and get those larger bugs fixed.

Let us know in the comments what you think of this update and if you have any dice ideas post away. We’re in production on many new ones now.

P.S We like to inject some humor into these updates and where possible into the game. If you're not a fan of jokes we understand, but let us have this OK. Be excellent to each other!

notes.title: v2.8 Big Update is here
notes.notes:
I hope your scroll-wheel is ready because this is one of the biggest updates to RISK yet and you’re gonna be scrolling for a while. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/a3a7a6b8d3be36ea4c0510f155f3aa6341b0ae3a.png

To celebrate this update we also want to share this amazing artwork we commissioned from Ryan Lee to celebrate the Strongholds & Castles map pack. Check out his work, give him a follow. 

We’ve focused on new content and quality of life fixes. We hope you enjoy and wish all our players a safe and fun holiday season. 

There’s also a LOT of work done but not released in 2.8 which will be rolled out in updates in early 2021. We’ll also be releasing our dice rolling code to GitHub so everyone can review and we can stop the conspiracies.  

Strongholds & Castles
Battle your way through four iconic locations from around the world. Strongholds & Castles map pack features our largest ever map -- Mont Saint-Michel! 

We heard you Big Map Fans. BMFs 4 LYF!

Mont Saint-Michel: 
Weighing in at 88 territories this map is a big cluster of fun. It’s also the kind of castle you build when you really hate having neighbors. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/e1155ab3952f4eaa53921a5a670568b139946123.png

Himeji Castle
Built in 1333 it would have been even more legendary had it been built in 1337 but they were ahead of schedule.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/79cd50da6995c016c3967432102c788e3de71b96.png

Conwy Castle
This is the type of castle you draw as a kid with the iconic circular towers around the wall. Built in 1289 for £15,000 which seems like a bargain in retrospect considering it’s still standing today and you’d struggle to build a small studio apartment for that.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/043fb70f468d5f4cb2e1a174766460d2e9141869.png

Red Sands Fort 
Honestly if you told me these were up for rent on AirBNB as instagrammer getaway hotels I would believe you. Built for the Second World War long before influencers were a thing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/22a1dade6b26154e3a18003a72059b2ad316adef.png


Fantasy II
It’s Xmas time so we’ve doubled down with another four new maps! Reveal the mysteries of strange and haunted places, explore enchanted lands and ancient ruins in our Fantasy II map pack. 

Dracula’s Castle
Oh Drac I love what you’ve done with the place!! It’s actually Bran Castle but that sounds like a breakfast cereal so we’re going with Dracula’s Castle as a much more tourist-friendly name.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/34a9f5fd22f7bafe65519a85284664d4844f8ba6.png

Lost Temple:
We even asked master cartographer, Dyson Logos to licence us the design for Lost Temple.  Check out his site and support his Patreon. There’s so many amazing maps for your own D&D sessions at home.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/5bc97a48b7b7eb8f96c4a3d52d6adf6dafc2e14b.png

Jules Verne's Mysterious Island
Based off the Jules Verne novel by the same name (well it was originally L'Île mystérieuse but I struggle to type those umlauts, are they umlauts? what are those things called?) We thought we’d tap into the classic, but importantly public domain, fantasy. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/a0362936cf8f26deb1a38f2f9629806b616ca6e0.png


The Younger Scrolls
Oddly familiar yet totally different map! Enjoy waging battles on this magical land.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/118cc02101123627a7e37a0dd182bdd8875726c2.png


Free Stuff!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/386c32d9b75b8454b6890c7693f4fb583c0c8799.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/f042da3069628c320c4b50a4fdc7c522e0e5e4c4.jpg

Love free stuff? Of course you do. We’ve teamed up with prime gaming to offer free in-game loot. Pretty sweet deal. They help promote RISK, you get free stuff. It’s a triple WIN! 

To redeem: Just log into RISK: Global Domination on mobile (IOS or Android) with your Prime account to claim free maps, emotes and more!  The rewards will roll out over the next 6 months!


Settings & RISK Account
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/9d94aa4bcdb8ecf38673bdea3288fd981b17974a.png

We’ve added categories to Settings for a better user experience AND added new options for account security. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/db281b48be1b7711c2ebb75302bb05952afe7177.png

16+ age players can now:
add an email as well as password to ensure your purchases and progress are secure and easy to recover with email verification.
Log in with your email only (once you’ve set it up) if you forget your username.

How's that for a slice of fried gold?    
(Please comment below if you get this reference and want to see more British comedy injected into these updates)

Same user account and multiple devices

As of v2.8 players can still play across devices and platforms under one account, but will no longer be able to play games at the same time on multiple devices. This is to:

 curb potential cheating
 prevent server errors caused by updates from simultaneous games for one account.


When you log on to a second device while active on another, your session will be disconnected from the first device. If you attempt to return to the second device you will be asked which device to continue to use.

Battle Log

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/74dff2e9df84995415f2d7c72fdf1dad5ba497dc.png

We’ve beefed up the Battle Log. This will help remove some of the !?!? when playing but don't worry the beef is vegan safe.

We know some of the authentic RISK rules can be a bit obscure, so we’re now logging 6 different event types:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/eb72925cbf782703233a2a81bb737d17c493f554.png

Turn Start: details on troop & continent bonuses

 Card Trade: now shows forced trades / how many cards / if there was a 2+ territory card bonus / matching card combinations
 Attack: who attacked whom / territories and troop numbers
 Defeat: who defeated whom / territory cards seized
 Fortify: How many troops / from where to where
 Disconnects: for local player only (with a warning some events will not be recorded while they were disconnected)


For better clarity, we’ve added the details for the troop bonus calculations now. This helps a lot with the more obscure RISK rules, like the +2 troops when you occupy one of the territories on the cards you trade in.

If you’re playing with Fog of War, you’ll see fewer details of course:


 Turn Start: total troop only
 Card Trade: total troops only
 Player Defeated: full details shown
 Fortify: will only show details if both territories are visible to you on the map.


Other improvements:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/b744a8c0f54ec9e76d08190055ddfadfa7b9fd03.png

Ever wanted to review the battle log after your game finished? Now you can both on Game Over or while spectating as an eliminated player. 

We increased the max number of events from 30 -> 45. Work that scroll wheel! 
(this update was brought to you by the Scroll Wheel Union of America. “Scroll Wheels: keeping America scrolling since 1996”)

We reduced the triggers to auto-close the Battle Log to the essentials only: your turn start; a player defeat; Capitals game mode ‘active’ alert; zombie outbreak alert. User testing says 93% less annoying!

New ‘Six Strikes’ Suspension System

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/2bd4893a321ebab185a520109caf2e84ff5c5f31.png

The RISK ban hammer got a major update in v2.8. 

Previously, player suspensions from ranked multiplayer games could last anywhere between 1-30 days. This has now been replaced by ‘Six-strikes’ where each strike incurs a longer suspension for repeat offenders. Strike 1 is a 24 hr suspension and escalates up to a permanent ban for strike 6. This is also aimed at reducing the number of “burner/alt” accounts and to be less punishing tor players unfamiliar with our fair play rules e.g. don’t play with friends in Global Domination (pssst that’s what Play with Friends mode is for).


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/e9a33cfc8c63580e76a5173d0fb00eeb0c812044.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/3ae78c04f0d471b61820245db4bcf9fde56b808f.png

Previously we did a poor job of communicating to suspended players how long their suspensions would last. In v2.8 this is clearly shown on the home screen and by tapping the Global Domination button. In addition, players will now receive a direct in-app message from RISK admin at the start of a new suspension.

Fair Play
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/5c8c2a19518c4f937075222225d576d8760fd63d.png

We listen to our community feedback and requests, and with every release we commit a portion of our development to improving Fair Play. In v2.8 we’ve included many small to medium updates:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/7b55522640e5ec18667c52181e931513f5e381d3.png


Stalling
RISK v2.7 shipped with automated detection for unfair stalling (where an opponent could win but stalls in an attempt to force you to quit rather than finish). In v2.8, the Report Player now has ‘Stalling’ as an additional option. Tap on your opponent’s avatar to access.

Reporting Players

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/5bbdbf8b36e4bcbed11dd1fb695e5c146c852e5b.png

We often receive questions from our community about what happens to complaints submitted during a game using the report feature (above) for cheating, unfair or inappropriate behaviour. Reported players are flagged and actively monitored for 30 days using our automated tools. For players using v2.8+ we will now provide a direct message in-app to inform reporters whether any action is taken against the player they reported.

In addition, as of v2.8 if you have reported a player using the in-game reporting feature (or they have reported you) neither of you will be able to view a game hosted by the other that is in the available games to join list in Global Domination. 

Ranks

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/6439dcc02c45700cf2ae9d3f19f44f8d8b595fda.png

To counter unfair player targeting due to their rank, we’ve removed ranks from multiplayer lobbies, gameplay and game over. Rank filters for game hosts are still available. 
Also in v2.8 you can now tap avatars in the multiplayer lobby to view player profiles. 

Other Improvements
Thanks to our community feedback, we’ve addressed a few exploitable issues in v2.8:

Fix: Closing and restarting the app during a forced card trade will no longer allow a second trade.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/58c2ffefa422473b2f1f99a8d68aac2d60740c74.jpg

If the AI takes over due to player inactivity, they will no longer be able to see the map to wait for an opportunity to rejoin. The map will be 100% hidden as above.

Spectate mode is disabled during Fog of War games to prevent unfair collaboration.
Available games in Global Domination will now be named according to map rather than by the host player, to deter friends playing together.


Rules Change
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/88090d7a6a787b99651d3100936f9db61acda347.png

The progressive card bonus is now unlimited in 2.8. Previously it was capped at 60 troops.


Map Changelog
Major

 Ottoman Empire: Removed wrong connection between Far East > Caspian Districts. Added missing connection between Far East > Durrani.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544601/6cff70f1380104827add9a84d0fc1deddccb67ef.png


 Britannia: balancing change- adjusted & increased Continent bonuses.
 Moscow: balancing change- adjusted & reduced Continent bonuses.


Minor

 Supermax Prison: dotted connections more readable between continents
 Classic: Fixed overlapping names & label positions
 Moscow Advanced: Fixed misaligned Continent bonus labels


General fixes & improvements


 Major Fix: player alliances will automatically be broken if a player goes offline and the computer AI takes over. This is to prevent an exploitable bug where the AI would honour the alliance and never attack for the remainder of the game.
 Fix: for incorrect position for local player on the in-app leaderboard.
 Fix: Occupying 2 continents next to each other will no longer cause the continent outline highlight to be broken
 Fix: When selecting a territory to attack, the enemy troop temporarily appears on different territory and then on the correct one.
 Fix: for occasional dice disappearing during manual rolling
 Fix: for charging tokens for tutorial scenarios. 
 Added additional sound and vibration to the ‘Get Ready’ confirmation screen for multiplayer games. 
 Player verified badges and country flags added to game over and home screens
 Streamlined onboarding and login for new and existing players.
 Multiple UI improvements and minor fixes.



Phew!  I can't believe you scrolled this far!


Again thanks for playing and the support of the team at SMG and we can't wait to show you what we have planned for 2021!  We’re wrapping up soon for holidays but will have a support team on to answer questions. 

Don’t forget the officially community run Discord is also the place to chat with all the other RISK fans like you, well maybe not exactly like you as you’re special.
